nina: Noting follow-up from the overnight KV OOM. Short: fragmentation spike + small-object retention. Putting up a small action list. Reply with owner + ETA.

nina: Actions:
1) emergency soft-evict flag (temp) -> owner: ? -> ETA: 6h
2) three quick heap captures + flamegraphs -> owner: ? -> ETA: 24h
3) add `kv.frag_index` metric and dashboard -> owner: ? -> ETA: 12h
4) pointer-safety grep + audit for shard-sync change -> owner: ? -> ETA: 48h

omar: I'll do (1). plan: flip `kv.eviction.soft_pct=85` via canary (10% nodes) in us-west. smoke tests afterwards. ETA 3h.

sara: I'll pair on (4) with omar after captures. also add a small test harness for pointer sanity. ETA 36h.

omar: capturing heaps now on nodes x,y,z, ids hc-210556-a/b/c. uploading to s3.

ops-bot: [automated] Created ticket INF-6971 "KV fragmentation follow-up" link: https://issue.redwood/INF-6971

sara: metric suggestion: `kv.frag_index = free_frag_bytes / active_bytes` sample 15s, alert > 0.25 for 10m. also emit `kv.small_alloc_rate` (allocs <256B / min).

omar: added metric and provisional dashboard. will attach grafana link in ticket.

nina: good. checklist for 24h: soft-evict in canary, 3 heap captures uploaded, metric live, pointer audit started. we'll reconvene 24h. Ping me for blockers.
